--- header_pre ---
#define j0 _j0
#define j1 _j1
#define jn _jn
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#define yn _yn
#define gamma _gamma
#define lgamma _lgamma
#define tgamma _tgamma
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>

#else

#endif

#undef y1
#undef yn

#undef lgamma
#undef tgamma

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  // camera
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -12.5000f);
  glRotatef(16.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(-30.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -1.2000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float c, a; // color/brightness mix in [0,1] (planet + ring bands); comet orbit angle

  // banded gas giant: quad strips over latitude, bands swirled by t
  planet(rad, stacks, slices) {
    float latA, latB, cA, cB, lon, cLon, sLon;
    float y;
    // latA/latB = latitude angle at row i and i+1; cA/cB = cos(lat), shared by
    // the normal and the vertex so each cosine is taken once, not three times.
    // lon/cLon/sLon do the same for the per-column longitude angle.
    for(i, 0, stacks) {
      glBegin(GL_QUAD_STRIP);
        for(j, 0, slices + 1) {
          latA = -PI/2 + PI*i/stacks;
          latB = -PI/2 + PI*(i + 1)/stacks;
          lon = j*TAU/slices;
          cA = cos(latA);
          cB = cos(latB);
          cLon = cos(lon);
          sLon = sin(lon);
          y = sin(latA);
          c = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(9*y + 0.5*sin(3*lon + 0.6*t) + 0.4*t);
          glColor3f(0.46 + 0.34*c, 0.30 + 0.16*c, 0.62 - 0.20*c);
          glNormal3f(cA*cLon, y, cA*sLon);
          glVertex3f(rad*cA*cLon, rad*y, rad*cA*sLon);
          y = sin(latB);
          c = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(9*y + 0.5*sin(3*lon + 0.6*t) + 0.4*t);
          glColor3f(0.46 + 0.34*c, 0.30 + 0.16*c, 0.62 - 0.20*c);
          glNormal3f(cB*cLon, y, cB*sLon);
          glVertex3f(rad*cB*cLon, rad*y, rad*cB*sLon);
        }
      glEnd();
    }
  }

  // moon on a tilted circular orbit; caller sets the color
  moon(orbit, rad, speed, tilt) {
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(tilt, 0, 0, 1);
      glRotatef(speed*t, 0, 1, 0);
      glTranslatef(orbit, 0, 0);
      glutSolidSphere(rad, 16, 12);
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  // translucent ring band: bright inner lip fading outward
  ring(inner, outer, fade) {
    glBegin(GL_QUAD_STRIP);
      for(j, 0, 41) {
        c = 0.75 + 0.25*sin(j*0.9);
        glColor4f(0.70*c, 0.58*c, 0.88*c, fade);
        glVertex3f(inner*cos(j*TAU/40), 0, inner*sin(j*TAU/40));
        glColor4f(0.45*c, 0.50*c, 0.85*c, 0.25*fade);
        glVertex3f(outer*cos(j*TAU/40), 0, outer*sin(j*TAU/40));
      }
    glEnd();
  }
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);

  // ===== Ringed gas giant under nebula skies =====
  // NOTE: stays well under the 8192 flattened-command budget --
  // the sphere loop costs stacks*(slices + 1)*10 flat commands.
  glClearColor(0.04, 0.04, 0.1, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);

  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0, 1.7, 0);

    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(-6*t, 0, 1, 0);
      planet(1.55, 18, 18);
    glPopMatrix();

    glColor3f(0.78, 0.72, 0.64);
    moon(3.9, 0.22, 34, 9);
    glColor3f(0.55, 0.66, 0.8);
    moon(5.1, 0.16, -21, -14);

    // translucent passes last: rings over the planet, then the comet
    glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
    glEnable(GL_BLEND);
    glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(26, 1, 0, 0.3);
      ring(1.95, 2.45, 0.40);
      ring(2.55, 3.05, 0.20);
    glPopMatrix();

    // comet: bright head + tail fading along its eccentric orbit
    glBegin(GL_LINE_STRIP);
      for(i, 0, 30) {
        a = 0.7*t - 0.06*i;
        glColor4f(0.55, 0.85, 1.0, 0.6*(1 - i/30));
        glVertex3f(5.6*cos(a), 1.1*sin(2*a), 4.2*sin(a));
      }
    glEnd();
    glPointSize(6);
    glBegin(GL_POINTS);
      glColor4f(0.85, 0.97, 1, 0.95);
      glVertex3f(5.6*cos(0.7*t), 1.1*sin(1.4*t), 4.2*sin(0.7*t));
    glEnd();

    // leave shared GL state the way we found it
    glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
    glDisable(GL_BLEND);
  glPopMatrix();
